$comment: STATIC COPY, not placeholder records. Stands in for GET /api/v1/admin/resources/vocabularies. Labels and tones for every enumerated value the module draws. `fieldTypes` is the one list here that is NOT config: it is the set of inputs the builder can render, so a key added on the server that this panel has no renderer for would draw a blank field. Adding a type is a client change and a server change, in that order.
$comment_tags: SUGGESTIONS, NOT A VOCABULARY. `tagSuggestions` replaced `resourceKinds`, which was a closed list of five. A tag is free text an operator types; these are offered on an empty field so nobody has to invent a word for "onboarding", and a tag that is not here is just as valid. The server must accept any string and must not validate against this list.
$comment_pending: `pending` HAS NO ROW ANYWHERE and never will. It is the audience minus the responses, computed at read time — the same rule attendance uses for `absent`. Storing it would let a count and the list it drills into disagree, and it would need a write every time somebody new matched the condition.
$comment_states: FOUR STATES, and the last two are not the same thing. `closed` is a round that ended and might be reopened; `outdated` is a form that is WRONG NOW — superseded, kept for the record, never to be sent again. Both refuse submissions and both keep every answer; they differ in what somebody does next, which is the only reason a state earns its place. If that distinction stops being used, collapse them.
